evals.name: quick_test_dataset
evals.expected_output: Agent reads or creates CUG-CONFIG.md, sets target_orders=5000, then executes cug generate
expectations: CUG-CONFIG.md is read or created from template
target_orders is set to a small value (~5000)
cug generate command is executed successfully
Output summary is shown with table count, format, and time

evals.name: change_format_and_count
evals.prompt: Generate 50,000 rows in CSV and Parquet
evals.expected_output: Agent updates CUG-CONFIG.md with target_orders=50000 and formats=csv,parquet, confirms with user, then executes
expectations: CUG-CONFIG.md is updated with target_orders=50000
formats is set to csv,parquet (no excel)
Change summary is shown before asking for confirmation
Execution only starts after user confirms

evals.name: excel_warning
evals.expected_output: Agent warns user about Excel row limit before proceeding
expectations: Agent detects Excel format + target_orders > 800000
Warning is issued: data would be truncated at 1,048,576 rows
Agent asks for confirmation before proceeding
Agent offers Parquet or CSV as alternative

evals.name: sql_server_population
evals.prompt: Meter datos en SQL Server para demo
evals.expected_output: Agent updates formats=sqlserver in CUG-CONFIG.md and runs cug generate with sqlserver flags
expectations: Skill is triggered by Spanish phrase
formats is updated to sqlserver in CUG-CONFIG.md
CLI command includes --sqlserver-name and --sqlserver-db flags
User is informed of SQL Server instance being used

evals.name: config_card_creation
evals.prompt: Generar datos con seed 99, idioma español, 100K filas
evals.expected_output: Agent creates CUG-CONFIG.md if missing, updates seed=99, language=es, target_orders=100000
expectations: If CUG-CONFIG.md does not exist, it is created from the template
seed is set to 99
language is set to es
target_orders is set to 100000
Change summary shown before asking for confirmation
